data.long_description:
Discover modern living in this beautifully designed 1-bedroom apartment in Park Horizon Tower 2, offering 658.85 sq.ft. of well-planned space in a vibrant and family-friendly community.

This contemporary residence features a bright open-plan living and dining area, complemented by large windows that allow natural light to fill the space. The modern kitchen is thoughtfully designed with quality finishes and ample storage, making it both functional and stylish.

The spacious bedroom includes built-in wardrobes and easy access to a well-appointed bathroom, creating a comfortable and private retreat. With its efficient layout, this apartment maximizes every square foot, making it ideal for professionals, couples, or investors seeking strong rental potential.

Property Details:

1 Bedroom
1 Bathroom
Size: 658.85 sq.ft.
Open-plan living and dining area
Modern kitchen with quality finishes
Built-in wardrobes
Bright and airy layout

Residents of Park Horizon Tower 2 enjoy access to premium amenities including a swimming pool, fully equipped gym, landscaped podium areas, children’s play areas, and 24-hour security. The tower is ideally positioned close to retail outlets, dining options, parks, and major road networks, ensuring excellent connectivity and everyday convenience.

This property offers the perfect balance of comfort, style, and accessibility in one of Dubai’s most sought-after residential communities.

Contact us today to arrange a viewing or for more information.
